notes.title: Directive 8020 at Gamescom 2025
notes.content: [h2][b]Catch Up with the Gamescom Summary Recap[/b] [/h2][p]We’ve wrapped everything into a Gamescom 2025 Recap, available now. Expect behind-the-scenes scares, developer insights, and a closer look at the choices—and consequences—players experienced at the show.[/p][previewyoutube="Dmqh6m7vSBI;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]Take a deep dive into this year's event…[/b] [/h2][h3][i]Tuesday - [/i]Opening the Airlock with NVIDIA [/h3][p]Gamescom 2025 began with a moment we’ve been looking forward to: showcasing [i]Directive 8020[/i] alongside NVIDIA. We were really excited to show how the game takes advantage of cutting-edge technology—DLSS with multi-frame generation, DLSS Super Resolution, ray tracing with indirect lighting, and full path tracing—helping every shadow, corridor and flicker of movement aboard the Cassiopeia feel that little bit more alive…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/4de7c319c13411478a12c5f399c525e3d584ef46.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Wednesday & Thursday – First Contact with the Prologue [/h3][p]Across these two days, around 100 members of the press and content creators stepped aboard the Cassiopeia for a curated look at the prologue.[/p][p]In this demo they got hands-on playing as sleep technician Carter, who, alongside fellow sleep tech Simms discovers a mysterious hull impact. It’s up to them to explore the ship, repair the damage and return inside the Cassiopeia. However, as you would expect from a Dark Pictures game, this does not go to plan…[/p][p]Check out the [b]13 Minutes of Gameplay[/b] that we revealed at Gamescom:[/p][previewyoutube="6ibY6uKgpvw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Your decisions can impact each crewmates survival and this demo showcases an early choice which can have dire consequences.   [/p][p]Early previews from outlets like [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Tq1JaZgB6g"][b]PlayStation Corner[/b][/url][b],[/b] [b][url="https://www.gamesradar.com/games/survival-horror/supermassive-games-new-sci-fi-horror-game-directive-8020-doesnt-just-let-you-redo-your-worst-mistakes-it-also-speaks-to-my-completionist-heart/"]GamesRadar[/url][/b], and [url="https://www.thegamer.com/the-dark-pictures-anthology-directive-8020-gamescom-preview/"][b]TheGamer[/b][/url][b] [/b]described the experience as tense and oppressive, noting how the threat aboard the ship creeps closer in ways they didn’t always expect. They also had particular praise for the way the 'Turning Points' system lets players revisit key decisions and explore all the branches of the story.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/84c13979141059b2ec0950eedec2b53b5687c7b5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/ccb6dc59a63fd564bdea61598dc5ebaae9564551.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/96c27df28ba1cb61c99ec3472862d510933f4291.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/8719a3a2951d4095148a36623ecbccfd5f4c2a2b.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]The demo gave hands-on access to the new feature which enables you to rewind your choices, which was described by the Creative Director’s interview with [b][u][url="https://www.pcgamer.com/games/horror/supermassive-games-is-adding-a-new-tool-to-its-next-horror-game-directive-8020-thatll-give-players-a-second-chance-to-save-their-favourite-characters/"]PCGamer[/url][/u][/b][b] [/b]as:[/p][p][i]"The Turning Point system is more for explorer players who want to achieve everything," Will Doyle says. "The Turning Point screen becomes like a sticker book where you're literally going to try and fill it all in. We offer hints for unlocking different branches on the Turning Point screen—sometimes, you need slightly arcane ways to unlock them. It's not as simple as just rewinding to a choice. You have to have made a choice previously, or a character's trait has to be at a certain level to get this one."[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/98c9e2614db11d42eaac781df2fe5742d32dd102.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Will also highlighted in an interview with [b][u][url="https://www.techradar.com/gaming/directive-8020-developers-on-finally-introducing-the-one-feature-that-i-always-wanted-in-until-dawn-and-why-it-will-change-how-you-play"]Tech Radar[/url][/u][/b] how you can play in the classic Dark Pictures mode rather than using Turning Points:  [/p][p][i]"At the same time, for the other group of players, we're saying, if you do want to live and die by your choices, play on survival mode.[/i] [i]We put in the mode for you that removes the ability to rewind and you get an achievement for completing the game in that mode. And then at the end of that mode, when you get to the end of the story, you can turn it on…"[/i][img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAAAXNSR0IArs4c6QAAAARnQU1BAACxjwv8YQUAAAAJcEhZcwAADsMAAA7DAcdvqGQAAAANSURBVBhXY2BgYGAAAAAFAAGKM+MAAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p][i]Directive 8020 releases 2026, [/i]add [i]it [/i]to your wishlist today[b] [/b]—because what you’ve seen so far is only the beginning.[/p][h2][b]WISHLIST NOW[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255370/Directive_8020/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet the full Cassiopeia Crew
notes.content:
The Cassiopeia is fully outfitted as a colony craft but will be flying with a vastly reduced crew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/508b0919ec903251490961af51fff668a9fd555c.jpg[/img]
Comprising of astronauts from around the globe, and accompanied by Corinth CEO Lamarcus Williams, the Cassiopeia’s crew have been purposefully selected and rigorously tested to ensure they are perfectly equipped to undertake this mission on behalf of humanity.

Corinth’s mission to Tau Ceti f is more than exploration – it’s a commitment to building a future beyond Earth. Learn more about the full crew of pioneers leading the way at: 
[h2][url=https://www.thedarkpictures.com/games/directive-8020#crew]Directive 8020.com[/url][/h2]

[h3]Tune into the Future Games Show Summer Showcase next Saturday June 7th for your next look at Directive 8020.[/h3]

notes.title: Meet the Crew - Brianna Young
notes.content:
Pilot Brianna Young is one of Corinth’s most promising talents. Driven, focused, and fiercely capable, she joins the mission to Tau Ceti f to honour her father’s legacy - and forge her own. 

She’s one of a kind. Well... she used to be. 

[previewyoutube=fC4e2RnJ_Hc;full][/previewyoutube]
Brianna Young (played by Lashana Lynch) is one of Corinth’s rising stars, and pilot of the Cassiopeia. Daughter of esteemed astronaut Bill Young, she's wanted to follow in his footsteps since she was a child. 

Young has confidence in her abilities, and the skills to back it up. Whether it’s graduating top of class at flight school, or playing in Corinth’s soccer team, Young always pushes herself. 

When her father passed away a few years before the mission, she threw herself into training even more. Stafford took on the role of her mentor, becoming something of a father figure. 

Young undertook this mission to prove she had what it takes – not just to her late father, but also to herself.

[i]“I’ve always wanted to fly, the joy of it, the freedom of it. To just take your life in your hands and soar.” [/i]


This concludes our playable character spotlight, but there are many more characters whose survival will depend on your choices...

notes.title: Meet the Crew - Josef Cernan
notes.content:
Aboard the Cassiopeia, every team member matters. Technical Engineer Josef Cernan is not only a systems expert - he’s the connective tissue that keeps the mission running smoothly, both technically and emotionally. 

How well the mission goes is up to you. 

[previewyoutube=BjOHfMWm-A8;full][/previewyoutube]

Josef Cernan is a Technical Engineer with a perceptive understanding of how things work – not just hardware, but people too.

In his youth he moved from Turkey to Holland to study Technical Engineering, proving himself to be a brilliant problem-solver. At the same time, he discovered and began to practice Buddhism, which shaped his outlook on life and how to make the most of it. 

After making a promise to his late partner to do everything in his power to live a life he could be proud of, Cernan decided to sign up for the Cetus Mission. 

Kind-hearted and open-minded, Cernan is often seen as the ‘glue’ that bonds the crew together (as well as their resident philosopher). He believes every problem, no matter how hard it may seem, has a solution. 

[i]“The problems humanity are facing today are no different – If it’s a life of death situation. I vote life.”[/i]


Our fifth and final character spotlight touches down next week!

notes.title: Meet the Crew - Samantha Cooper
notes.content:
Dr. Samantha Cooper brings a rare combination of medical expertise and battlefield resilience to the Cassiopeia. A seasoned medic and a survivor, she is unwavering in her mission to protect life. 

No matter the cost. 

[previewyoutube=0s1daJ5z98k;full][/previewyoutube]
Dr. Samantha Cooper is a skilled medic who first learned her trade as part of the Marines’ medical evacuation team. Unfortunately her time in medevac ended abruptly following the infamous ‘Jessops Station’ tragedy, where Cooper was the sole survivor from her team. 

After this, Cooper worked hard to overcome her trauma. Her oldest friend Zoe Anders helped her recover and later Cooper repaid the favour by recommending Anders as the replacement Science Officer for Corinth’s mission. Overall, Cooper has emerged from her trauma as a resilient person, focused on moving forward. 

Her dedication to her craft and amiable nature are what make her the perfect choice for the Cassiopeia – she’s not just a doctor with a good bedside manner; she’s a fighter who will put everything on the line for the future of humanity. 

[i]“People everywhere have tough times, and now more people than ever before are facing something terrible. I want to bring them hope - we all need a little hope.”[/i]


Be on the lookout for the next character spotlight coming soon!

notes.title: Meet the Crew - Nolan Stafford
notes.content:
A veteran explorer and the first man on Mars, Commander Stafford now leads Corinth's mission with the same determination that defined his career. For him, this is more than a mission - it’s a legacy. 

A legacy that is in your hands...

[previewyoutube=2Bjo60UZ5mg;full][/previewyoutube]

Nolan Stafford, the first man on Mars, is a natural leader. As commander of the mission to Tau Ceti f, Stafford brings a respected authority, as well as a lifetime of discovery.

Stafford is the founding father of Corinth’s space programme. He has been instrumental in the success of many historic missions, but none more important than this. This mission marks his last before retirement, and he hopes to give it his all.

The ship’s pilot, Brianna Young, is the daughter of his closest friend and fellow astronaut, the late Bill Young. On their mission to Mars together Stafford promised Bill that he would watch out for Brianna at all costs.

Stafford has immense trust in his whole crew. He leads from the front and would never leave a crewmate behind!

[i]“I’m proud and humbled to be leading the finest crew our planet has to offer… so that you can watch your children grow up, and their children for generations to come.”[/i]


Stay tuned for the next character spotlight, coming next week!

notes.title: Meet the Crew - Laura Eisele
notes.content:
Laura Eisele doesn’t just build systems - she builds futures. As Senior Mission Officer, her vision and technical mastery have shaped the Cassiopeia from blueprint to launch. 

No one – or thing – knows the ship better.

[previewyoutube=ph-otxiBxb0;full][/previewyoutube]

Laura Eisele is the lead designer of the mission and architect of the Cassiopeia. From early in her career she’s been noticed and awarded for her work, with her peers describing her as ‘scientifically brilliant’. She holds herself and others to high standards because of this. 

Whilst her understanding of machines and theorems is unparalleled, she finds communicating with her peers harder. From the outside she may appear cold and rational, but deep down she wishes to connect with others – even if it doesn’t come naturally.

Eisele joined this mission to push both herself and the future of humanity – testing the limits of what she’s capable of. Eisele has left her mark across the mission through her designs – including the ship’s computer, The Oracle. Always diligent, she’s prepared for every scenario… except actually touching down. 


[i]“I designed this mission with integrity and skill, and I hope the crew will treat it similarly. There's no room for an error. Ultimately if something goes wrong because of the design, that's on me. If we fail, it is because I have failed.”[/i]



This is the first in our weekly series of character trailers to help you get acquainted with the Cassiopeia crew on their voyage to Tau Ceti f.

notes.title: Story Trailer and Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
Debuted at Sony’s State of Play showcase, this new trailer takes you deeper into the dangers onboard the spaceship Cassiopeia, teasing new characters, environments, potential death scenes and a deadly alien threat. 

[previewyoutube=9CtX9O7nZeQ;full][/previewyoutube]
“The team at Supermassive Games has worked tirelessly to craft a narrative experience that melds sci-fi exploration with spine-chilling horror, where every choice could lead to a disastrous death.  Today we’re unveiling some new layers to our story, exploring fragile alliances, unseen threats, and the limits of human resilience when faced with our deepest fears. We’re venturing into uncharted territory: the unsettling abyss of space.” - Will Doyle, Creative Director at Supermassive Games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/aeb6377922535448a42de597bd8df6bee74dbf7d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Story[/h2] 
Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. Twelve light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone.

Hunted by an alien organism capable of mimicking its prey, the crew of the Cassiopeia must outwit their pursuers to make it home alive. As they battle to survive, they are confronted with the hardest choice of all: to save themselves, they must risk the lives of everyone on Earth. 
In space, death takes many forms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/e555d5b60ecf9147ff6be3c67853c2240748d89d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Key Features [/h2]
[h3]ALIEN INVASION [/h3]
The colony ship Cassiopeia is infected with an alien organism, capable of transforming into any member of the crew. While you may be human, others in your crew may not be, and killers can hide behind familiar eyes. New stealth mechanics have been added to help players evade these deadly foes: you must keep your wits about you as enemies can emerge from unexpected places and you’ll need to sneak and hide to get past these deadly alien stalkers.
     
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/ab42f1d63dc58c1b55244ea176b031d207e8c8c4.jpg[/img]
[h3]BRAVE RECRUITS  [/h3]
Introducing the Cassiopeia’s crew. You’ll control five crew members over the course of this expedition, but as paranoia and fear builds, so does distrust. With their lives in your hands, your decisions will determine not only the crew’s fate, but all of humanities too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/23fd5ad432d39e776d96734344a7bad8031fb6f5.jpg[/img]
[h3]NEW MECHANICS  [/h3]
Directive 8020 introduces several new tools. Throughout the game, you can use these to locate secrets, solve puzzles and overcome enemies. 

The mission is all about survival, so every tool has its purpose in helping you think on your feet and staying alive.

•	[b]FLASHLIGHT[/b] – As is to be expected from our games, you’ll spend a lot of time creeping around in the dark! Just be careful when using your flashlight, as aliens can spot the beam. 
•	[b]SCANNER[/b] - You'll have a scanner at your disposal for detecting electronics and remotely activating systems, helping to distract enemies and overcome obstacles. 
•	[b]MESSENGER[/b] - If you’re trying to stay under the radar, your messenger lets you communicate and strategize with crewmates.
•	[b]WEDGE TOOL[/b] - Made for opening doors… but as a last resort, can also be used as a weapon to temporarily stun enemies, giving you a chance to slip away and evade death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157804/91ada01f5a779a94da6a8fa8a4890c753a35f9b3.jpg[/img]
[h3]THE DARK PICTURES[/h3]
Fans of Supermassive Games’ previous releases will be pleased to know that the DNA of the Dark Pictures is still present – in fact, everything you love about the Dark Pictures is still here, from branching plotlines through to impossible choices and split second QTE’s. In addition, gameplay has been redesigned, polished, and amped up to bring more of a threat when exploring the environment.  

Directive 8020 lands October 2nd 2025, with pre-orders available from June 2025.
